decision.reason: The pilot edge contract defines evidence questions but not a complete, source-backed regional boundary or anchor allowlist. The anchor registry lacks a sealed Nicomedia anchor and exact physical-reference records for Sangarius and Lefke. Do not infer an allowlist from current candidate hits.

approvalRequirements: Resolve every unresolvedAnchorRef to a source-backed record or explicitly document why it is not required for the selected edge subset.
Declare the exact pilot edge subset this scope serves.
Declare a unique allowedAnchorIds list that exists in the canonical 1326 anchor registry or an explicitly versioned physical-reference registry.
Record scope rationale, source references, uncertainty, and reviewer approval before status may become APPROVED.
